text: Make the throughput review catch slowdowns and keep it moving. The median time per landed job rose from 25.4 minutes (throughput review of 29 Oct) to about 60 minutes (1 to 4 Nov), and nothing flagged it: the review proposes one design request and then waits, and that request (20261029-160024-80qj) sat queued for 6 days, so no review since has looked again. Change the review so that (1) each run compares the latest median with the previous review's and names the stages that grew, even while a design request is open; and (2) when the median grew by more than a quarter, it queues a request at high priority naming the stage that grew most and the measured minutes. Acceptance: a test where the median rose from 25 to 60 minutes with a design request open, and the review names the grown stages and queues a request; a test where the median is flat and nothing is queued.
